name: Career and life coach

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: 3-month coaching package
services.story: The main story: Renee's 3-month package, 6 coaching sessions of 60 minutes for $330, paid in full when booked, after the free intro call shows it's a fit. Each session uses one of the 6.

services.name: Follow-up session
services.story: A $35 follow-up session by video, or the same in a plan every 2 weeks. A card is saved for the $20 late-cancel fee, and the $35 is charged when Renee texts DONE.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: On-site coaching session
services.story: The main story: a $179 on-site coaching session at Alex's company. Nothing is taken. Sam bills the company once a month, its own way, under the company's contract.

services.name: On-site coaching session
services.story: The same $179 session for a company with no contract: nothing is taken, and Rosie texts the bill to Alex, who pays with the company's card.

services.name: Team coaching half-day
services.story: A team coaching half-day for Alex's team, priced from the company's answers at $640. Sam OKs it. A $160 deposit now, and the $480 rest on the bill after.

questions_before_times: Which coach? The customer names one, or sees the practice's coaches listed with no ranking.
What it's about, in a few words: career, leadership or life goals. No details.
By video, by phone, at the office, or at your workplace?
A single session, the 3-month package, or a plan?
New or returning client? A new client starts with the free intro call.
safety_stop: someone says they may hurt themselves
someone says they may hurt someone else
danger right now, or a medical emergency
license: None by default: coaching needs no state license. It's a switch filled from each state's form, and where a state's form names one, it's asked then. The business gives its registration.
messages_never: ["anything the client shares about their job, health or money: goals, an employer, pay, a layoff, a diagnosis","what was said in a session","why a booking was declined","crisis words"]
